_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global manufacturer and marketer of semiconductor devices, principally DRAM, NAND Flash and NOR Flash memory, as well as other innovative memory technologies, packaging solutions and semiconductor systems for use in leading-edge computing, consumer, networking, embedded and mobile products.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' (FY2010 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a memory maker (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global manufacturer and marketer of semiconductor devices, principally DRAM, NAND Flash and NOR Flash memory, as well as other innovative memory technologies, packaging solutions and semiconductor systems for use in leading-edge computing, consumer, networking, embedded and mobile products.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' (FY2010 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a memory maker (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.02x; -65% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.86; conservative 2yr +714%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY04-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.6%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.5-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 median

BULL.desc: EPS +40.5%/yr (FY04-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.5%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY04-FY10 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2011-02-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.02x (35.2% downside to Bear $7.58 / +1528.5% upside to Bull $190.53) | Adj composite 2.86 vs market 1.00: gap +1.86 [UNDERVALUED] | -65% above the EPP floor $33.30 (18x FY11E $1.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: +714.4% total (+357.2%/yr) | At 6.3x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $15.47 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +29.4% YoY in Q1 FY11, forward revenues +29.4% (Q1 FY11 revenue growth (no Q2 FY11 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
